articles.title: Anthropic stock falls below $83 IPO price, but analysts are still largely positive
articles.summary: Shares of Anthropic fell 7% on Tuesday, sending the stock below the artificial intelligence company's $83 IPO price. articles.title: Best Buy reports comparable sales growth of 6.1%, highest in five years
articles.summary: The consumer electronics retailer reported comparable sales growth of 6.1%, a significant beat over expectations of 2.3%, according to market intelligence platform StreetAccount. The company said that growth was its highest in five years. It reported a domestic comparable sales increase of 6.2% and international comparable sales growth of 4.9%.

articles.title: Signal joins United Airlines, banks in limiting AI agents over customer risks
articles.summary: Privacy-focused messaging application Signal is tightening protections against artificial intelligence agents that can access information displayed on users' screens, citing concerns over privacy and security. Signal said AI agents built into mobile operating systems, such as Google's Gemini and Apple's Siri with onscreen awareness, can "scan" information on users' screens, potentially capturing and storing Signal data outside its control.
